## What template are you missing?

Pick one (or describe a new category):

- [ ] Philosophy doc (`package-templates/docs/philosophy/`)
- [ ] AI prompt template (`package-templates/prompts/`)
- [ ] Script (`package-templates/scripts/`)
- [ ] CI example (`package-templates/ci-examples/`)
- [ ] Profile (`package-templates/profiles/`)
- [ ] Example project (`examples/`)
- [ ] Other: <describe>

## Why is it needed?

What problem does it solve that the existing templates do not?

## Reference materials

Links, papers, blog posts, internal docs (anonymized), or other OSS that informed your thinking. The more we can verify upstream, the faster we can scope it.

## Profile compatibility

Which profile(s) should this be compatible with?

- [ ] `react-nextjs`
- [ ] `react-vanilla`
- [ ] `expo-rn`
- [ ] `node-cli`
- [ ] `supabase-rls` (addon)
- [ ] Stack-agnostic / cross-profile

## Acceptance ideas

If you have thoughts on what would make this template "done", list them. Example: "covers Server Action authorization for Next.js App Router with both happy-path and rejection cases".

## Additional context

Anything else.
